title: 1-bit Dither Studio
blurb: Turn a photo or a generated scene into two-ink bitmap art with Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, Bayer or threshold dithering. Photos never leave your device.

title: Punch-Card Loom
blurb: Punch an 80-column card by tapping or typing a phrase, and the holes weave a textile repeat. Export the cloth as PNG or SVG.

title: Moon and Tide Mood Card
blurb: A pixel moon, a sun arc and a tide-like band for any date and latitude band, in colours that follow the hour. Approximate, not a tide table.

title: Court Lines Poster
blurb: A pickleball court at true 20 by 44 foot proportions as a two-colour poster, with a seeded rally traced across it.
